name: Brandes et al. 2023 ClinVar in-frame indel and stop-gain pathogenicity benchmarks
description: ROC-AUC of ESM1b-based scores, CADD and simple baselines for pathogenic versus benign ClinVar in-frame indels and stop-gain variants.

attributes.task: Pathogenicity classification of in-frame indels and stop-gain variants
attributes.scope_note: Two ClinVar-derived labelled sets built by the authors. Only CADD among published predictors is compared on indels, because most indel predictors are trained on ClinVar; no published predictor is compared on stop-gains.
attributes.source_locator: Results 'ESM1b can predict the effects of multiresidue variants' and Fig. 4 legend; Methods 'Generalized effect scores for indels and stop-gain variants', 'Baseline scores of indel and stop-gain variant effects'; Supplementary Methods 'Indels and stop gain ClinVar benchmarks'

name: ESM1b absolute-valued PLLR indel score (Brandes et al. 2023)
description: ESM-1b in-frame indel score: the absolute value of the pseudo-log-likelihood ratio between the mutated and wild-type protein sequences, so likelihood gains and losses both count as damaging.

attributes.parameters: esm1b_t33_650M_UR50S; sequences longer than 1,022 amino acids scored on a 1,022-residue window around the variant; |PLL(mut) - PLL(WT)|
attributes.source_locator: Methods 'Generalized effect scores for indels and stop-gain variants' paragraph 3; Supplementary Table 2 sheet 'Table_of_results_indels' row 'ESM1b-aPLLR'

name: ESM1b minimum-LLR stop-gain score (Brandes et al. 2023)
description: ESM-1b stop-gain score: the lowest missense log-likelihood ratio among all possible missense variants in the protein region lost after the new stop codon.

attributes.parameters: esm1b_t33_650M_UR50S missense LLRs over the whole protein (sliding windows above 1,022 amino acids); minimum over the lost region
attributes.source_locator: Methods 'Generalized effect scores for indels and stop-gain variants' paragraph 4; Supplementary Table 2 sheet 'Table_of_results_stop_gains' row 'ESM1b-minLLR'

name: ESM1b PLLR indel score (Brandes et al. 2023)
description: ESM-1b in-frame indel score: the pseudo-log-likelihood of the mutated protein sequence minus that of the wild-type sequence.

attributes.parameters: esm1b_t33_650M_UR50S; sequences longer than 1,022 amino acids scored on a 1,022-residue window around the variant; PLL(mut) - PLL(WT) ('vanilla' PLLR)
attributes.source_locator: Methods 'Generalized effect scores for indels and stop-gain variants' paragraphs 1-3; Supplementary Table 2 sheet 'Table_of_results_indels' row 'ESM1b-PLLR'

name: ESM1b weighted PLLR indel score (Brandes et al. 2023)
description: ESM-1b in-frame indel score: the pseudo-log-likelihoods of the mutated and wild-type sequences each divided by sequence length before subtraction, to correct for indel size.

attributes.parameters: esm1b_t33_650M_UR50S; sequences longer than 1,022 amino acids scored on a 1,022-residue window around the variant; PLL(mut)/L(mut) - PLL(WT)/L(WT)
attributes.source_locator: Methods 'Generalized effect scores for indels and stop-gain variants' paragraph 3; Supplementary Table 2 sheet 'Table_of_results_indels' row 'ESM1b-wPLLR'

name: ClinVar missense pathogenicity, ESM1b head to head with one other method on the variants both score (Brandes et al. 2023 Fig. 2f, Supplementary Table 2)
description: Global ROC-AUC and balanced PRC-AUC of ESM1b and one other method, each on the ClinVar variants that both methods score.

attributes.protocol: Scores used directly (no training on these labels). For each comparator, restrict the labelled set to the variants with both an ESM1b and a comparator score; compute global ROC-AUC and balanced PRC-AUC (downsample to equal pathogenic and benign counts at 80% of the minority class, mean over 100 repeats) for both methods on that set.
limitations: Benchmark built by the ESM1b workflow's authors (author-reported for ESM1b).
Each comparator has its own variant set, so comparator values are comparable only with the ESM1b value on the same set, not with each other.
